name: nd3 unannotated class method return satisfies interface contract
source: interface Shape { area(): number } class Circle implements Shape { r: number; constructor(r: number) { this.r = r; } area() { return 3 * this.r; } } class Sq { area() { return 4; } } function main(): void { const s: Shape = new Circle(2); const t: Shape = new Sq(); console.log(s.area(), t.area()); }
